interpretation.cuts: C008, C009, and the proved visited-state C013 cut are tested on every proper prefix of each shortest witness. Applicable cuts should produce a shorter witness; failures are recorded.
interpretation.necessary_search: N'' searches are exact only for their fixed finite graph and budget parameters. A global NO certificate is recorded only for an explicit empty-language reason.
interpretation.scope: No result transfers to subtype-derived instances or Problem 1.7.
interpretation.shortestness: A returned shortest word has all words through the preceding lengths checked. For two states, no witness after length one uses the exact N''(0,0) shortcut below; capped searches remain UNKNOWN.
interpretation.two_state_shortcut: Each two-state boundary slice has a shortest accepting path of length at most one. Such words have only empty/full borders. Thus N''(0,0) is empty exactly when no witness exists. The census checks this finite encoding space; the binary all-word implication is proved in lean/Subtail/TwoState.lean.

scope: abstract BorderAvoid; exhaustive two-state binary partial instances

targeted.interpretation: Targeted rows preserve a base admissible word while adding flags. Exact instance budgets are reported only when the strong finite search exhausts its graph; otherwise the row remains UNKNOWN.
